billingCheckout.title: Histae subscription
billingCheckout.intro: Sign in to your Histae account to purchase or manage a subscription on the website.
billingCheckout.sent: If these details match an existing account, a code will be sent.
billingCheckout.renewal: Auto-renewing subscription with no free trial. Stripe will confirm the displayed price before payment.
billingCheckout.active: Your Premium access is confirmed by Histae.
billingCheckout.free: Your account currently uses the free plan.
billingCheckout.onboarding: Complete registration in the application before subscribing.
billingCheckout.store: Your subscription is managed by the store shown below. Manage it with that provider.
billingCheckout.error: The request failed. Please try again shortly.
billingCheckout.invalid: Check the UUID and phone number.
billingCheckout.auth: The account or code is invalid or expired. Request a new code.
billingCheckout.limited: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
billingCheckout.existing: A subscription or purchase attempt already exists. Check your subscription before continuing.
billingCheckout.storage: Session storage is unavailable. No new payment was started.
billingCheckout.storePrice: Prices in the applications are displayed by their store.
billingCheckout.session: Payment sessions last 30 minutes. No new account will be created.
